stories.title: El decreto que el Gobierno no ha llevado al BOE obliga a los caseros a pagar hasta 12 mensualidades a los inquilinos si no prorrogan el contrato

en.title: The decree that the Government has not taken to the BOE obliges landlords to pay up to 12 months to tenants if they do not renew the contract
en.summary: A government decree on automatic rental renewal establishes strict limits for landlords and establishes indefinite rental agreements, potentially requiring them to pay tenants significant compensation if contracts are not extended.

stories.title: Un incidente entre dos pilotos obliga a aterrizar de emergencia en Arabia Saudí a un vuelo que se dirigía a Israel

en.title: An incident between two pilots forces an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia for a flight headed to Israel
en.summary: A flight from the United Arab Emirates to Israel diverted to Saudi Arabia after an altercation between crew members in the cockpit. Passengers and crew members subdued the assailant.

stories.title: Pamplona será la sede de los Premios Goya de 2027

en.title: Pamplona will host the Goya Awards in 2027
en.summary: Pamplona has been selected to host the 2027 Goya Awards ceremony at the Navarra Arena in February, continuing the recent tradition of rotating the event across Spanish cities.

stories.title: Pamplona acogerá la gala de los premios Goya 2027 el próximo 6 de febrero

en.title: Pamplona will host the 2027 Goya Awards ceremony on February 6
en.summary: Pamplona has been chosen to host the 2027 Goya Awards ceremony on February 6. The awards have become an itinerant event across Spanish cities in recent years.

stories.title: Pamplona acogerá la 41ª edición de los premios Goya

en.title: Pamplona will host the 41st Goya Awards
en.summary: Spain's film academy announced that the Goya Awards ceremony on February 6 will take place in Navarra for the first time, marking an effort to decentralize national cinema.

stories.title: Una pelea entre los pilotos de un avión con destino Israel activa una alerta de emergencia y su aterrizaje en Arabia Saudí

en.title: A fight between pilots of a plane bound for Israel triggers an emergency alert and its landing in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Israeli authorities are investigating whether one pilot attempted to crash an aircraft after it descended rapidly from 34,000 to 16,000 feet in under two minutes, with passenger intervention possibly preventing tragedy.

stories.title: El decreto que el Gobierno no ha publicado en el BOE obliga a los caseros a pagar 12 meses a los inquilinos para desistir de la prórroga

en.title: The decree the Government has not published in the Official Gazette requires landlords to pay 12 months to tenants to waive renewal
en.summary: A housing decree not yet officially published would require landlords to compensate tenants substantially if they wish to terminate indefinite rental contracts, potentially disrupting the rental market.

stories.title: Un vuelo a Israel es desviado a Arabia Saudí tras una violenta pelea entre los pilotos

en.title: A flight to Israel is diverted to Saudi Arabia after a violent fight between pilots
en.summary: Authorities suspect one pilot intended to crash an aircraft carrying over one hundred Israeli passengers.

stories.title: El Gobierno lanza una cuenta para invertir los ahorros en las empresas europeas

en.title: Government launches account to invest savings in European companies
en.summary: The government has created a new investment account allowing citizens to buy and sell shares in European companies over a five-year period with tax exemptions on gains up to 10,000 euros.

stories.title: Un vuelo comercial entre Dubái e Israel es desviado a Arabia Saudí tras una llamada de socorro

en.title: Commercial flight between Dubai and Israel diverted to Saudi Arabia after distress call
en.summary: A commercial flight was diverted to Saudi Arabia following a distress call related to an apparent altercation in the cockpit involving the pilots, with the cause of the dispute remaining unclear.

stories.title: El Gobierno crea una nueva cuenta para inversores con exenciones fiscales de 10.000 euros

en.title: Government creates new account for investors with 10,000 euro tax exemptions
en.summary: The government has established a new savings and investment account designed to encourage citizens to participate in financial markets supporting European companies, featuring tax incentives despite previous disagreements between economic ministries.

stories.title: El Gobierno aprueba una cuenta de ahorro con beneficios fiscales para fomentar la inversión en Bolsa europea

en.title: Government approves savings account with tax benefits to promote investment in European stock market
en.summary: The government has approved a new savings account allowing portfolio management without taxation and offering tax exemptions if held for five years, with the maximum contribution to savings insurance doubled to 10,000 euros.

en.title: The Ibex restores confidence
en.summary: A pause in oil and debt prices allows investors to approach the week's key inflation data with greater confidence. The Ibex index is expected to rebound after falling in four of the previous five trading sessions.

stories.title: Las principales medidas del nuevo decreto de vivienda, explicadas una a una

en.title: The main measures of the new housing decree, explained one by one
en.summary: Spain's official gazette published a new housing decree containing specific details and figures of government-approved measures across 96 pages of legislative text.

stories.title: ¿En qué valores de renta variable merece la pena invertir?

en.title: Which equity securities are worth investing in?
en.summary: An investment expert addresses questions about whether current conditions favor equity purchases and which stocks may offer the highest returns in coming years.

stories.title: El Gobierno incluye la cuenta europea de inversión en el decreto de vivienda

en.title: The Government includes the European investment account in the housing decree
en.summary: The Spanish cabinet approved a European savings and investment account and a long-term individual savings insurance product as part of urgent housing measures published in the official gazette.

stories.title: Más parches que no arreglan los alquileres

en.title: More patches that don't fix rentals
en.summary: Pedro Sánchez is accelerating the ratification of decrees to pressure his coalition partners into supporting them regarding rental issues.
